name: Culinary Dropout
tagline: Rebel gastropub fare, craft cocktails, live music, and backyard patio games
description: Located on North Orange Street just north of Chapman Ave and steps from Chapman University, Culinary Dropout serves elevated comfort food with a rock-and-roll attitude. Known for warm Soft Pretzels with provolone fondue, Wagyu pigs in a blanket, 36-hour pork ribs, ice-cold local draft beers, craft cocktails, and an expansive indoor/outdoor patio loaded with ping-pong, cornhole, and live weekend music.
historicNote: Situated in Old Towne Orange's historic industrial and citrus packinghouse corridor, converted into a high-energy indoor/outdoor culinary and entertainment hall.

specials.title: Weekday Kickoff Happy Hour
specials.description: $5 craft draught beers and wines by the glass, $10 featured craft cocktails, and $9 warm soft pretzels with provolone fondue at the bar.

specials.title: Taco & Nacho Tuesday
specials.description: $10 BBQ Pork Belly Nachos and $5 draft lagers during afternoon happy hour.

specials.title: Wine Down Wednesday & Pretzels
specials.description: 50% off select bottles of wine with purchase of an entree, plus $5 drafts during 3-6pm happy hour.

specials.title: Thirsty Thursday & Yard Games
specials.description: $10 signature cocktails (Room 42, Jalapeño Paloma) with complimentary access to outdoor ping pong and cornhole yards.

specials.title: Friday Sunset Happy Hour & Ribs
specials.description: $5 draught beers and $10 cocktails from 3-6pm, followed by Chef's slow-smoked 36-hour pork ribs dinner feature.

specials.title: Weekend Rock & Roll Brunch
specials.description: Brunch served 10am-3pm: Smokehouse Hash, Bacon & Egg Croissant, Chicken Sausage Omelet, and $10 morning eye-opener cocktails.

specials.title: Sunday Hangover Brunch & Patio Beats
specials.description: Weekend brunch favorites with $25 mimosa carafes and live acoustic sets on the outdoor patio.

events.title: Live Music on the Dropout Patio
events.description: Local rock, soul, and acoustic bands performing live on the outdoor stage while you play ping pong and yard games.

researchMetadata.verificationNotes: Verified 191 N Orange St location, hours (Mon-Thu 11am-10pm, Fri 11am-11pm, Sat 10am-11pm, Sun 10am-10pm), phone (714) 439-5566, happy hour Mon-Fri 3-6pm ($5 drafts/wine, $10 cocktails), and weekend brunch 10am-3pm.
